_meta.note: Phrases and patterns the Listing Check looks for in listing text (pasted text, or text extracted from a screenshot by the server). Case-insensitive whole-phrase match. severity: scam = classic fraud pattern, stop; critical = title/legal/structural risk; major = expensive risk, needs proof; caution = worth a question. Drafted by AI — review before launch. Never accuse a seller; frame as 'this is a common warning sign, ask about it'.

flags.explanation: Requests for wire transfers, gift cards or crypto — especially before you see the car — are classic scam patterns.
flags.ask_seller: Can I see the car in person and pay at a bank when we sign the title?

flags.explanation: Far-away sellers offering shipping through a 'protection' or escrow service they choose is a common fake-listing pattern.
flags.ask_seller: Where can I see the car this week?

match: price is firm due to emergency
flags.explanation: Urgency stories are often real, but scammers use them to rush buyers. Don't skip any checks.
flags.ask_seller: No problem — I can come today if I can do a quick inspection and test drive.

flags.explanation: Branded titles mean the car was declared a total loss or had serious defects. Resale value, insurance and financing are all affected.
flags.ask_seller: What happened to the car, and do you have repair photos and receipts?

flags.explanation: Without a title in the seller's name you may not be able to register the car — and it could be stolen.
flags.ask_seller: Can we meet when you have the title in your name?

flags.explanation: Mileage can't be trusted, which hides wear and affects value a lot.
flags.ask_seller: Why is the mileage marked unknown, and is there documentation?

flags.explanation: Normal for private sales, but it means problems after purchase are yours. A professional inspection matters more.
flags.ask_seller: Are you okay with me getting a pre-purchase inspection at a nearby shop?

flags.explanation: Refusing a test drive often hides transmission, engine or steering problems.
flags.ask_seller: I'd need a short test drive — can we do that with you in the car?

flags.explanation: 'Easy fix' problems are often not easy. Price it as if the repair is the expensive version.
flags.ask_seller: Has a shop diagnosed it? Do you have the code or the quote?

flags.explanation: Transmission repairs are among the most expensive.
flags.ask_seller: Has the transmission been diagnosed or serviced? Any records?

flags.explanation: Overheating and coolant loss can mean head gasket or engine damage.
flags.ask_seller: When did it start, and what has been replaced so far?

flags.explanation: Flood damage causes electrical and corrosion problems that can appear months later.
flags.ask_seller: Was the car ever in water? Is that on the title?

flags.explanation: Accident repairs vary from cosmetic to structural. Ask for repair records and get a body/frame check.
flags.ask_seller: Which shop repaired it and do you have the invoice or insurance report?

flags.explanation: An airbag warning means the airbags may not deploy in a crash.
flags.ask_seller: Has the airbag light been diagnosed?

flags.explanation: Removed emissions equipment is illegal on public roads in the US and can fail inspection.
flags.ask_seller: Is all emissions equipment installed and passing inspection?

flags.explanation: Unlicensed dealers posing as private sellers ('curbstoners') often sell cars with hidden problems.
flags.ask_seller: Is the title in your name? Can I see your ID next to it?

flags.explanation: Never send a deposit before seeing the car and the title.
flags.ask_seller: I'll bring payment when I see the car and title.

flags.explanation: Recently cleared codes or a disconnected battery can temporarily hide warning lights.
flags.ask_seller: I'd like to scan it with an OBD reader — is that okay?

flags.explanation: High mileage isn't bad by itself, but maintenance records become essential.
flags.ask_seller: Do you have service records, especially for the timing belt and transmission?

flags.explanation: Rust on body panels is cosmetic; rust on the frame or brake lines is a safety issue.
flags.ask_seller: Where exactly is the rust? Can I look underneath?
